MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTRY
396
27 - 9 / 40

Misc.No.630/40.    Bubbling Well
                   24th. September          40.

1.

REPORTED KIDNAPPING AT LANE 608, HSE. 43 YU YUEN ROAD
======================================================

At 5.10 p.m. 24-9-40 a telephone call, purporting
to come from a female named "Mrs 陸)", 608/43 Yu Yuen
Road, was received at this Station, reporting that a
kidnapping had occurred at this address.

The speaker was asked to come to the Station at
once to make a report of the affair. (It was in this
same lane, a short time ago, that members of a S.M.
Police party were taken into custody by Japanese
Military Police, when answering an armed robbery call)

As the person failed to put in an appearance at
the Station, a return telephone call was made to
22701, and the person at the other end said she knew
nothing of such a report.

D.D.J. "B" Division was informed of this, and he
instructed that the S.C.G.P. Bureau be requested to
render assistance to visit the address.

D.J. Greenfield, D.S. Shinokawa and S.I. Pan
visited the S.C.G.P.B. Headquarters. This authority
knew nothing of the report.

Meanwhile, D.S. Shinokawa informed the Japanese
Military Police of the report. Japanese Military
Police replied they would investigate the report, and

杂项编号 630/40。    静安寺路巡捕房
                   1940年9月24日

1.

报称在愚园路608弄43号发生绑架案
======================================================

1940年9月24日下午5时10分，本巡捕房接到一通电话，声称来自愚园路608弄43号一位名为“陆太太”的女士，报告称该地址发生了一起绑架案。

接线员要求报案人立即前来巡捕房就此事进行报案。（就在不久之前，同样是在这条弄堂内，几名公共租界警务处警员在出警处理一起持械抢劫案时，被日本宪兵队拘捕）

由于报案人未现身巡捕房，遂回拨电话至22701，接听电话的人表示对此类报案一无所知。

已将此事告知“B”区副督察长，他指示请求上海特别市政府警察局协助前往该地址调查。

格林菲尔德侦探督察、篠川侦探警佐和潘高级警员前往上海特别市政府警察局总部。该局方面表示对此报案毫不知情。

与此同时，篠川侦探警佐将此报案情况通报给日本宪兵队。日本宪兵队回复称他们将调查此报案，并

requested S.M. Police to await the result of their

Up to 6 a.m. 25-9-40, no further information

Further enquiries will be made during the

Det. Inspector

1 (第2页)

要求公共租界警务处等待其调查结果，结果将通过电话传达至本巡捕房。因此，公共租界警务处警员未前往该地址。
截至1940年9月25日上午6时，未收到进一步消息。
上午期间将进行进一步查询。
